I answered Tobias in a thread under his question in #central-random: the ticket is PD-4821.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026, a channel Tobias is in. That ticket has the Eastbank receiving-door import attached; the import file calls the doors E1/E2 while the booking sheet uses 01/02. No approval was needed, since a ticket number is an operational fact.
